test_description: Histogram dimensionality & pointer safety — verify NULL hist pointers never crash and compute_nll_from_histogram_checked rejects n_bins != 16
input_contract: Non-null 16-bin count array; nullptr and n_bins != 16 explicitly rejected without crash
independent_oracle: fork()-isolated NULL pointer probe + checked length API (15, 16, 17 bins)

expected.null_and_dim_guard: Explicit error/rejection on nullptr or wrong bin count (15, 17) without crash

actual.null_and_dim_guard: nullptr returns +Inf with 0 crashes; compute_nll_from_histogram_checked rejects n_bins=15/17 and accepts n_bins=16
